title: macros/<id>.md header
description: A macro's header. The JSON object between the --- lines only; the body is outside this schema. The body is its verbatim text.

label.description: The display name of the macro; never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the macro).

if.description: A JSON Logic condition for whether the macro is offered, or null for always.

format.description: The text format of the body: plaintext, markdown_block or markdown_inline.

instruction.description: Where to place the macro, joined with a newline; it holds the macro's own marker once.
